info.title: Travel Requirements Management API - AWS (Public Version)
info.description: Provides an API Gateway to manage travel requirements for the customer. The clients would be able to list, update, scan the customer's travel requirements.

CalculationFromCodeType.description: Basis of calculation for test and vaccine acceptance window

urlExpirationMillis.description: The expiration set on the presigned URL

captureSamplingRateMillis.description: Recommended sampling rate for capturing the image frame

resultSamplingRateMillis.description: Recommended sampling rate to get the scanning results

consumerId.description: The consumer id of the customer

labTestResult.description: The compliance result of the lab test

complianceDetail.description:
### Additional compliance result detail:
|Code|Reason|
|---|---|
|A|Compliance code A|
|B|Compliance code B|

|D|Compliance code D|

complianceTypeCode.description: The type of compliance for travel

reasonDetailCode.description:
"Reasons for validation failure:
    FORMS_SUBMITTED - Forms submitted and verified
    NO_ACTION - Customer has not uploaded forms yet
    PENDING_REVIEW - Review in progress
    REVIEW_FAILED - Review failed
    INVALID_FORM_SUBMITTED - Invalid form submitted
    IGT_REQUEST_FAILED - Call to IGT failed or timed out"

Compliance.description: Contains compliance details including rule sets

success.description: Status of uploadCompliance call from consumer

ComplianceResponse.description: The uploadCompliance response indicating whether the request was successfully completed or not.

consumerId.description: The consumer id of the customer

requirements.description: This sub-requirement list specifies which attributes in CONTACT_TRACING are required or not. If US transit, for example, PRIMARY_PHONE is required, and submitting that should satisfy CONTACT_TRACING.

phone.description: Can have 0, 1 or multiple phone numbers

code.description: Country code, e.g. US or USA

flightNum.description: Marketing Flight Number is assigned by the marketing carrier which uniquely identifies one operating line of Flight from an origin to a destination having zero, one or many stops. The FAA's ATC systems limit flight numbers to four digits (0001 to 9999).

marketingCarrier.description: List of carriers  that offer/offered a specific flight service in their schedule.

DatedMarketingSegment.description: The operation of a flight with a single flight designator between the point where passengers first board an aircraft and the passengers' final destination. A flight designator includes an airline code and a flight number. A flight segment can include any number of stops where passengers board and deplane the aircraft.

DatedOperatingLeg.description: The operation of a flight with a single flight designator between the point where passengers first board an aircraft and the passengers' direct destination.

DatedOperatingSegment.description: The operation of a flight with a single flight designator between the point where passengers first board an aircraft and the passengers' direct destination.

DerivedStatusCodeType.description: COMPLETE - when the overall requirement category has been completed. NOT_COMPLETE - when one of the requirements are still not satisfied. VERIFIED - when Agent has verified the travel documents or SFPD information.

Document.description: Used for Uploading Documents, e.g. PDF, Word Doc, JPEG or PNG

declined.description: - If passenger declined, name, value and type are NULL

code.description: Error Code represents a alpha-numeric error code received from the error

displayCode.description: Error Code represents a keyword equivalent of the error code

message.description: Message represents a textual description of a given error code

developerMessage.description: Developer Message represents technical details about the error message
developerMessage.example: Privacy verification failed - Invalid App Details

moreInfo.description: More details about the error as needed

checks.description: Provides which resources are checked and their statuses.

IdentityDocument.description: Document used by passenger as proof of identity for travel. E.g. PASSPORT, VISA, etc

id.description: The scanning UUID. This is used as the S3 file name (object key)

methodOfDataEntry.example:
'S' for Swipe, 'P' for Manually entered by passenger, 'A' Manually entered by the agent,
Blank or Null if unspecified

In combination with DataSourceCodeType, these indicators tell where the Identity 
or Travel Document was obtained by the API - and separate from PassengerV4 Method of Entry 
which DataSourceCodeType represents.

code.description: Error code sent by API w.r.t. each validation

field.description: Each exact property field that was validated

message.description: Each error message on the property level validation done by the API

advancePassengerInformation.description: DEPRECATED. Will be removed in a future version

infant.description: Indicates whether a passenger is an infant or not

nameNumber.description: Name Number is the combination of the last name number and the first name number of a passenger in a booking. Example: 03.02 represents the 3rd last name in the booking and the 2nd given name with that same last name.

firstName.description: First Name of the passenger in the PNR for request

lastName.description: Last Name of the passenger in the PNR for request

Passenger.description: Basic passenger details and travel requirements

PassengerLegHealthRequirement.description: Passenger health rules and requirements on a flight leg level

PassengerTripHealthRequirement.description: Passenger travel requirements and statuses on a trip level

declined.description: - If passenger declined, other fields are NULL or EMPTY

firstName.description: Only applies to emergency contact. PassengerContactData.ContactGivenName in PaxV4

lastName.description: Only applies to emergency contact. PassengerContactData.ContactSurname in PaxV4

countryCode.description: If emergency contact, this is the 2-character country code, e.g. US instead of 01.  PassengerContactData.ContactCountry in PaxV4

phoneNumber.description: If emergency contact, PassengerContactData.ContactPhone in PaxV4

required.description: DEPRECATED. Will remove in future versions Indicates if a travel requirement type is required, not required, or conditional

requestedForms.description: DEPRECATED. Will remove in future versions

testAppointmentLocalDateTime.description: DEPRECATED. Will remove in future versions Test appointment schedule in local date and time

reusable.description: Indicates the user has consented to store or reuse a requirement

digitalVerificationEligible.description: Indicates whether a requirement is digitally verifiable or not. Usually applies to Inbound to the US and DL have dedicated web page forms to collect data. E.g. Contact Tracing, US address, etc.

returnDateRequired.description: DEPRECATED. Will be its own Requirement.Type = RETUNRDATE

returnDate.description: DEPRECATED. Will be moved and renamed as OnwardTravelInfo.onwardDate

returnDateDeclined.description: DEPRECATED. Will be moved and renamed as OnwardTravelInfo.declined

verified.description: DEPRECATED. Will be its own status Requirement.Status = VERIFIED

travelDocuments.description: New location in 3.0.5. From AdvancePassengerInformation.travelDocuments This contains primary and secondary travel docs by default

contactInformation.description: New location in 3.0.5. From AdvancePassengerInformation.contactInformation - On Retrieve if request.type is CONTACT_TRACING, this field is NOT NULL - On Submit, if contactInformationForAll is NOT NULL, this field SHOULD BE NULL - On Submit and type=TRACING, this field is required UNLESS declined

emergencyContact.description: New location in 3.0.5. From AdvancePassengerInformation.emergencyContact - On Retrieve if request.type is EMERGENCY_CONTACT, this field is NOT NULL - On Submit, if emergencyContactForAll is NOT NULL, this field SHOULD BE NULL - On Submit and type=EMERGENCY, this field is required UNLESS declined

consent.description: Indicates consent to upload has been given by customer

saveToProfile.description: Allows user to save identity document to profile when added to a booking

country.description: When submitting the secondary doc self-declaration, this is the intended country for the submission.

cityOfTransactionOccurrence.description: The intended checkin or active trip origin airport.

requirementsResourceId.description: The UUID from POST /requirements using confirmation,ticket or credit card

confirmationNum.description: Confirmation number or record locator Id

fields.description: Request filter - Flight,Passenger,Passport,Requirements, CompletionStatus (If not supplied, return all)

RequirementsResponse.description: Response object when querying travel requirements or after submitting the primary travel document such as the passport.

requirementsResourceId.description: The UUID from POST /requirements using confirmation,ticket or credit card

RequirementStatusCodeType.description:
Requirement status type,
  Green Status Indicators
    - APPROVED
    - PRESENT
    - OVERRIDE
    - EXEMPTED
    - POSITIVE
  Not Green Status Indicators
    - NOT_PRESENT
    - NOT_APPROVED
    - PENDING
    - NOT_OK
    - NEGATIVE
    - ERROR

RequirementStatusSourceCodeType.description:
The compliance status has been updated based on the following sources:
  - A - Agent (Override from Agent)
  - P - Partner (DEPRECATED - use V - Vendor)
  - V - Vendor
  - R - Rules Engine (Override from Business)
  - S - Self Declaration (Override from Customer)

RequirementOption.description: List of various requirement sub types

documentStream.description: Base64 string representation of the document or image

fileContentType.description: upload file type for presigned url

fileName.description: upload file name for presigned url

consent.description: Indicates consent to upload has been given by customer

RequirementUploadRequest.description: Request structure for uploading a requirement

documentUploads.description: List of documents uploaded with status

url.description: AWS preSigned URL for form uploads

objectKey.description: UUID of filename for S3 key

RequirementUploadResponse.description: Response structure for requirement upload payload

SecurityRestriction.description: Description from PassengerSecurityStatus API: A specific travel restriction from a government or airline

issuingGovernmentCountryCode.description: Country code of the government issuing the security status. Empty if security status was issued from an airline. The following two fields (issuingGovernmentCountryCode and issuingCarrierCode) are mutually exclusive.

issuingCarrierCode.description: Airline code of the airline issuing the security status. Empty if the security status was issued by a government. The following two fields (issuingGovernmentCountryCode and issuingCarrierCode) are mutually exclusive.

issuingSourceTypeCode.description: Type code identify the source (system/process) of the security info | | 01-Security vetting performed by a government System | | 02-CBP status issued by a government system          | | 03-Name match to a government watchlist              | | 04-Name match to an airline watchlist                | | 05-Manual over-ride/assignment an airline            | | 99-Other/unknown                                     |

internalSecurityStatus.description: Security status code/value assigned to the passenger. Internal host code/value.

receivedSecurityStatus.description: Security status code/value assigned to the passenger. Issuing country/airline code/value received.

supplementalInformationCode.description: Optional supplemental code sent by the issuing Government. Converts to provide additional information or instructions related to the security status assigned.

supplementalInformationText.description: Optional supplemental text sent by the issuing Government. Provides additional information or instructions related to the security status assigned.
supplementalInformationText.example: CONTACT THE DHS RESOLUTION DESK AT: 1-800-CALL-DHS

SecurityStatus.description: Description taken from Passenger Security Status API: Security Vetting Result for a specific passenger. This will be the overall security status including a name match indicator if PNR name matches Security name. If any travel restrictions are sent back from an airline or government, they will be included in Security Restrictions list.

overallSecurityCode.description: Overall security code | | 00-Clear                            | | 01–Selectee                         | | 02–Do not board                     | | 03–Clear-TSA preCheck eligible      | | 04–Insufficient or missing SFPD     | | 05-Selectee1-SSSS on all legs       | | 06-Selectee2-SSSS on first leg only | | 07-Clear-TSA precheck eligible      | | 08-Clear-Low risk rules based       |

overallProcessCode.description: Overall processing code | | 000–OK to process  | | 001–Do not process |

dhsEstaStatusCode.description: ESTA-USCBP code | | Z-Travel authorization via ESTA not applicable                                                      | | A-VWP participant passport – Approved travel authorization via ESTA on file                         | | B-VWP participant passport – No application for travel authorization via ESTA on file               | | C-VWP participant passport – US authorized travel document required (ESTA denied)                   | | D-CBP response code for no valid US document on file                                                | | E-VWP participant passport – No EVUS for travel via ESTA on file                                    | | P-CBP response code for pending status result                                                       | | R-CBP response code for matching source found but adverse information exists that prevents boarding | | T-CBP response code for timeout status result                                                       | | X-Insufficient data to provide ESTA status                                                          | | 1-Inhibited                                                                                         |

pnrSecurityNameMatch.description: Name match indicator - Does the PNR name match security name?

verifyID.description: ID Verified indicates if an agent has verified the document.  Used for DHS VID process.  True - document needs to be verified by agent. Default value is false.

reason.description: Additional reason detail associated to the status code

TimeWindow.description: Time window a travel requirement is valid for

estimatedArrivalLocalDateTime.description: Estimated arrival on local date and time

scheduledArrivalLocalDateTime.description: Scheduled arrival on local date and time

estimatedArrivalUTCDateTime.description: Estimated arrival on UTC date and time

scheduledArrivalUTCDateTime.description: Scheduled arrival on UTC date and time

TransportArrival.description: The action or process of arriving of a transport vehicle in any place or location.

estimatedDepartureLocalDateTime.description: Estimated departure on local date and time

scheduledDepartureLocalDateTime.description: Scheduled departure on local date and time

estimatedDepartureUTCDateTime.description: Estimated departure on UTC date and time

scheduledDepartureUTCDateTime.description: Scheduled departure on UTC date and time

TransportDeparture.description: The action or process of leaving of a transport vehicle from any place or location.

bookingFirstDepartureLocalDate.description: Departure date of first flight in the PNR

bookingLastArrivalLocalDate.description: Arrival date of last flight in the PNR

passengers.description: List of passengers in the PNR

firstDepartureLocalDate.description: Departure date of first flight in the trip

lastArrivalLocalDate.description: Arrival date of the last flight in the trip

tripDirection.description: Identifies the direction of travel for the customer, whether it is inbound or outbound with respect to a specific country.

tripOriginCountryCode.description: Identifies the Origin Country Code of the customer's current trip segment in a PNR where services begin. (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format)

tripDestinationCountryCode.description: Identifies the Destination Country Code of the customer's current trip segment in a PNR where services end. (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format)

Trip.description: Trip represents one directional set of contiguous flight segments for a booking.

objectKey.description: bucket UUID key from file name

OFACInfo.description: Additional requirement document when inbound to Cuba

touristCardPresent.description: Evaluate SSR OFAC in the PNR
